units.source_text: 命妇答道：“并非胡言乱道，万岁爷也如此想。

en.t: The gentlewoman replied, "It is not wild nonsense; His Majesty thinks so too.

units.source_text: 他说：‘我确是真心爱她，但也何必如此过分，以致惊人耳目？

en.t: He said, 'I truly loved her with all my heart, but why did it have to go so far as to shock everyone who heard and saw it?

units.source_text: 这就注定恩爱不能久长了。

en.t: That itself doomed our love to be short-lived.

units.source_text: 现在回想，我和她的盟誓，原来是一段恶因缘！

en.t: Looking back now, the vows she and I made were truly an ill-fated bond.

units.source_text: 我自信一向未曾做过招人怨恨之事。

en.t: I believe I had never before done anything to invite another person's resentment.

units.source_text: 只为了此人，无端地招来了许多怨恨。

en.t: Only because of her, I brought so much resentment upon myself for no reason.

units.source_text: 结果又被抛撇得形单影只，

en.t: In the end, I was left abandoned and utterly alone,

units.source_text: 只落得自慰乏术，人怨交加，变成了愚夫笨伯。

en.t: with no way to comfort myself, burdened by people's resentment, and reduced to a foolish, clumsy man.
This too must be karmic retribution from a former life!'

units.source_text: 他反复申述，泪眼始终不干。”

en.t: He repeated this again and again, and his tearful eyes never dried."

units.source_text: 她这番话絮絮叨叨，难于尽述。

en.t: Her account was rambling and long, too difficult to recount in full.
